field.label: Interface Pattern
field.help: Regular expression matching the network interface names to use.

field.label: Beacon
field.help: Advertise this node using multicast on matching interfaces.

field.label: Listen
field.help: Discover other nodes using multicast on matching interfaces.

field.label: Port
field.help: Port for incoming peer connections discovered through multicast. Use 0 to select a port automatically.

field.label: Password
field.help: Optional password for peer connections established through multicast discovery.

field.label: Priority
field.help: Priority assigned to peer connections established through multicast discovery.
